review_scope: Public U.S. distribution of extracted legal text, metadata, and approved legal XML; original mirrored files are not included.

default.rights_basis: No source-specific redistribution determination has been recorded.
default.review_note: Full text is withheld until the source is reviewed.

archive_members.default_note: Internal ZIP, DOCX, and XLSX members are omitted from the public search package to avoid duplicating embedded graphics, themes, metadata, and other non-document assets.

uscode_current.review_note: Official OLRC U.S. Code XML extracted from the agency bulk ZIP.

uscode_current.rights_basis: Federal statutory text and OLRC employee-created bulk data; 17 U.S.C. 105 and the government-edicts doctrine.
uscode_current.review_note: Only the official XML archive members receive full-text and legal-reader treatment; download pages and ZIP containers remain link-only.

ecfr_current_immigration.rights_basis: Federal regulatory text and OFR/GPO employee-created bulk XML; 17 U.S.C. 105 and the government-edicts doctrine.
ecfr_current_immigration.review_note: Official government bulk XML is included in the legal reader.

uscis_policy_manual.rights_basis: Official USCIS employee-authored policy material is generally a U.S. Government work under 17 U.S.C. 105.
uscis_policy_manual.review_note: Only extracted text is redistributed; the mirrored webpage/PDF and branding are excluded.

uscis_policy_manual_attachments.rights_basis: Official USCIS policy attachments are presumed federal employee works unless a document-specific notice says otherwise.
uscis_policy_manual_attachments.review_note: Document-specific copyright notices trigger link-only treatment.

uscis_law_policy_indexes.rights_basis: Official USCIS policy and adjudicative material is presumed federal employee work unless marked otherwise.
uscis_law_policy_indexes.review_note: Only extracted text is redistributed; forms, graphics, and original binary files are excluded.

dos_9fam.rights_basis: The public Foreign Affairs Manual is official Department of State policy created in the course of federal duties.
dos_9fam.review_note: Extracted manual text is included; original webpage assets and attachments are not redistributed.

eoir_policy_manual.rights_basis: Official DOJ/EOIR employee-authored policy material; 17 U.S.C. 105 and DOJ public-domain reuse policy.
eoir_policy_manual.review_note: Only extracted text is redistributed; DOJ seals, photos, and original files are excluded.

eoir_precedent_decisions.rights_basis: Official federal adjudicative opinions; 17 U.S.C. 105 and the government-edicts doctrine.
eoir_precedent_decisions.review_note: Published opinion text is included; original PDF graphics and any separately authored exhibits are not included.

doj_immigration_denaturalization.rights_basis: Official DOJ employee-authored manual and litigation material; 17 U.S.C. 105 and DOJ public-domain reuse policy.
doj_immigration_denaturalization.review_note: Only extracted text is redistributed; DOJ branding and original webpages are excluded.

cbp_border_search_and_directives.rights_basis: Official CBP material is generally a federal work, but CBP's website reuse policy contains noncommercial language and third-party exceptions.
cbp_border_search_and_directives.review_note: Extracted text is included for noncommercial research distribution; original pages, seals, photographs, and binaries are excluded.

ice_enforcement_detention_sevp.rights_basis: Official ICE/DHS employee-authored material is generally a U.S. Government work under 17 U.S.C. 105.
ice_enforcement_detention_sevp.review_note: Only extracted document text is included; spreadsheet internals, media, website assets, and original binaries are omitted.

dol_foreign_labor.rights_basis: Official DOL employee-authored material is generally a U.S. Government work under 17 U.S.C. 105.

govinfo_case_law_catalog.rights_basis: Catalog titles, official URLs, and source metadata are retained; API response bodies are not redistributed.
govinfo_case_law_catalog.review_note: Use the official link to obtain the court document.

govinfo_case_law_documents.rights_basis: Official federal judicial opinions; 17 U.S.C. 105 and the government-edicts doctrine.
govinfo_case_law_documents.review_note: Opinion text is included; third-party filings or exhibits require separate review.

federal_register_immigration.rights_basis: Official federal rulemaking and presidential documents; 17 U.S.C. 105 and the government-edicts doctrine.
federal_register_immigration.review_note: Extracted official text is included; document-specific notices trigger link-only treatment.

agency_sitemap_inventories.rights_basis: Only official URL inventory metadata is distributed.
agency_sitemap_inventories.review_note: Sitemap bodies and unrelated site content are not included.
